title: Word Pair Recall · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Word Pair Recall · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner chooses two pairs of common words. The partner says both pairs once, then gives the first word of each pair. The lead supplies the matching second word for each pair. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Word Pair Recall, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The lead supplies the matching second word for each pair.
recall.why: The lead supplies the matching second word for each pair.
